title: The first live M mint occurs
description: M0 recorded the first live mint of M by MXON, establishing the operational launch boundary for the base token.
notes: Launch is tied to the first documented live M mint.

title: Falcon Finance launches USDf
description: Falcon Finance opened the protocol to public access on 2025-04-30, making core USDf minting and redemption functions available to users.
notes: Day-level boundary follows Falcon Finance's dated official public-launch announcement; the earlier closed beta is not treated as unrestricted public launch.

title: dForce launches USX on Ethereum mainnet
description: dForce launched its lending and synthetic-asset protocol on Ethereum mainnet with USX as the protocol dollar.
notes: Later USX Finance branding is treated as product continuity pending complete organization-lineage review.

title: Anzen launches USDz
description: Anzen introduced USDz as an RWA-backed tokenized dollar supported by private-credit and asset-backed collateral structures.
notes: Official retrospective material establishes June 2024 but not a reviewed day-level date.

title: Avalon deploys USDa
description: Avalon introduced USDa as a Bitcoin-backed overcollateralized dollar within its CDP and CeDeFi product system.
notes: Official timeline material establishes November 2024 but not a reviewed day-level date.
